ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What type of ant is Ant D?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image horizontally arranges several ant illustrations, each with a letter label below it. The ant on the far right is labeled D; overall it is light yellow to golden brown, its body and legs are relatively thin, and its appearance is lighter than the other darker ants. Then reason: The question asks what kind of ant Ant D is. According to the visual identification rule for this type of ant diagram, in which small, light yellow/golden-yellow ants correspond to Pharoah/Pharaoh ant, label D corresponds to Pharoah/Pharaoh ant. Therefore the answer is Pharoah Ant.
